text: My daily routine is simple but consistent. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, with a short lunch break around noon. Three times a week, I go to the gym after work to stay active. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, or read a book. I try to go to bed before eleven so I can wake up feeling fresh and ready for the next day.
